content: Service Oriented Communication realization with configured protocol Description: The Communication Management shall realize the Service Oriented Communication with the configured protocol binding. Rationale: The application code should use service oriented communication independently of the actually configured protocol. Dependencies: – Use Case: One application is used in multiple vehicle lines but the used communication protocols are different in the two vehicle lines, e.g. in one case it uses SOME/IP and in another case it uses local IPC.
